item_name: Rothco Military ECWCS Gen III Level 2 Balaclava
item_short_desc: Part of the Extreme Cold Weather Clothing System (ECWCS), the Military Generation III Balaclava is a light yet warm head covering. Made of a Polyester/Spandex blend, this balaclava wicks away moisture and is one size fits most. It's designed to provide cold weather protection while keeping you dry and comfortable. The one-size-fits-most design ensures convenience for various users, while the soft and snug fabric offers comfort for prolonged wear. Built with durability in mind, this balaclava is made to withstand harsh environments.
